notes.title: Crash fixes for playtest build
notes.notes:
[Crash fix] In some cases, gc discards dynamic materials before the asynchronous loading is complete, leading to a crash.
Other crash fixes related to upgrading cards, skipping cinematics, player number assignment,  network failure

notes.title: Game Speed Test
notes.notes:
This build includes modification to the game speed as well as improvements to responsivity. Please provide feedback on the general feel of the game speed. Note that some animations may seem too fast now--for example, some tackles--but we're interested in feedback in general on game speed, controllability, and realism.

- Players should move at more realistic speeds (40yd between 4.5-5.3s)
- Ball is no longer "floaty"--gravity is more realistic 
- Tweaked pass speed and trajectory
